hints.title: Counting Difference Reduction
hints.text: Express the count of contiguous segments with an exact sum as the difference between counting segments with sum at most the goal and at most the goal minus one.

hints.title: Monotonic Window Expansion
hints.text: Since elements are non-negative binary values, the window sum expands monotonically as the right end advances. Shrink from the left whenever the sum exceeds the threshold.

hints.title: Two-Pass Window Calculation
hints.text: Define a helper function atMost(k). If k is negative, return 0. Use a sliding window with left and right indices. Add right to sum, shrink left while sum > k, and accumulate right - left + 1. Return atMost(goal) - atMost(goal - 1).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) subarray pairs causes Time Limit Exceeded on arrays with up to 30,000 elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Computing atMost(goal) - atMost(goal - 1) runs in two linear passes with strictly constant additional memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize monotonic window sum behavior or alternatively prefix sum frequency count in O(N) time.
complexity.notes: The prefix-sum frequency map approach is O(N) time and O(N) space, while two-pass sliding window achieves O(1) space.
